segments.text:
V. 22.
Moſes gave you circumciſion—The Senſe is, Becauſe Moſes enjoined you Circumciſion (tho' indeed it was far more antient than him) you think it no Harm to circumciſe a Man on the Sabbath: And are ye angry at me (which Anger had now continued ſixteen Months) for doing ſo much greater a Good, for healing a Man, Body and Soul, on the Sabbath?
